name: A2A DESIGN Quote Agent
description: A structured scoping and indicative quotation service for digital, AI and automation projects.

authentication.description: Authenticated operation is required for private commercial quoting. Public demo mode is seeded and read-only.

skills.name: Request a quote
skills.description: Parse a project brief and return a structured indicative quote artifact.

skills.name: Clarify requirements
skills.description: Ask only for missing information that changes scope or pricing.

skills.name: Revise a quote
skills.description: Update an existing quote when authorised requirements change.

skills.name: Fit scope to budget
skills.description: Return controlled options within configured commercial boundaries.

skills.name: Compare quote options
skills.description: Compare full scope and value-engineered routes.

skills.name: Get quote status
skills.description: Return the current status of a quote task or artifact.

skills.name: Request human review
skills.description: Mark a quote or consequential action for human approval.

skills.name: Get service catalog
skills.description: Return configured A2A DESIGN service packages and optional modules.

skills.name: Get pricing constraints
skills.description: Return the commercial policy boundaries available to the quoting agent.
